summary: Rock: 100–140 BPM backbeat drums, power chords and bVII, driving 8th-note bass
body: Drums: kick 1 and 3, snare 2 and 4, 8th hats or ride; fills at phrase ends.
Harmony: I–IV–V with the mixolydian bVII; power chords.
TakeDo has no guitar instrument: an overdriven synth or organ stands in.

Apply: pattern/basic-rock on the drums, then pattern/prog-rock-characteristic-1 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 100–140 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
